cases.statement:
CALL () {
  OPTIONAL MATCH (eff_c:PDCorrection {status: 'active'})
  OPTIONAL MATCH (eff_c)-[:CORRECTS]->(eff_t)
  WITH eff_c, collect(eff_t.id) AS eff_named
  OPTIONAL MATCH (eff_d:PDDocument) WHERE eff_d.current_version_id IN coalesce(eff_c.scope, [])
  WITH eff_c, eff_named, collect(eff_d.id) AS eff_docs
  WITH collect(CASE WHEN eff_c IS NULL THEN null
                    ELSE eff_c {.*, named: eff_named, docs: eff_docs,
                                all: eff_c.scope = ['all']} END) AS eff_corrections
  WITH eff_corrections,
       reduce(eff_all = [], eff_one IN eff_corrections | eff_all + (CASE
    WHEN eff_one.operation = 'exclude_link'
      THEN [eff_p IN [[eff_one.targets[0], eff_one.targets[1]],
                      [eff_one.targets[1], eff_one.targets[0]]] WHERE eff_p[0] IN eff_one.named
            | {key: eff_p[0] + '|' + eff_p[1] + '|' + coalesce(eff_one.link_kind, '*'),
               all: eff_one.all, docs: eff_one.docs}]
    WHEN eff_one.operation IN ['resolve_mention', 'unresolve_mention']
         OR (eff_one.operation = 'include_link' AND eff_one.link_kind = 'resolves_to')
      THEN [eff_m IN eff_one.targets[0..1] WHERE eff_m IN eff_one.named
            | {key: eff_m + '|*|resolves_to|A', all: eff_one.all, docs: eff_one.docs}]
    WHEN eff_one.operation = 'different_identity'
      THEN [eff_p IN [[eff_one.targets[0], eff_one.targets[1]],
                      [eff_one.targets[1], eff_one.targets[0]]] WHERE eff_p[0] IN eff_one.named
            | {key: eff_p[0] + '|' + eff_p[1] + '|resolves_to|A',
               all: eff_one.all, docs: eff_one.docs}]
    WHEN eff_one.operation = 'split'
      THEN [eff_m IN eff_one.targets[1..] WHERE eff_m IN eff_one.named
            | {key: eff_m + '|' + eff_one.targets[0] + '|resolves_to|A',
               all: eff_one.all, docs: eff_one.docs}]
    WHEN eff_one.operation = 'replace_interpretation' AND size(eff_one.targets) = 1
         AND eff_one.targets[0] IN eff_one.named
      THEN [{key: 'doc|' + eff_one.targets[0], all: eff_one.all, docs: eff_one.docs}]
    ELSE [] END)) AS eff_hides,
       reduce(eff_all = [], eff_own IN eff_corrections | eff_all + [eff_rival IN eff_corrections
         WHERE eff_rival.id <> eff_own.id
           AND any(eff_shared IN eff_rival.named WHERE eff_shared IN eff_own.targets)
           AND ((
     (eff_own.operation = 'include_link' AND (eff_rival.operation = 'exclude_link' AND (eff_rival.link_kind IS NULL OR eff_rival.link_kind = eff_own.link_kind)) AND (eff_rival.targets = eff_own.targets OR eff_rival.targets = reverse(eff_own.targets)))
  OR ((eff_own.operation = 'same_identity' OR (eff_own.operation = 'include_link' AND eff_own.link_kind = 'same_as')) AND (
        (eff_rival.operation = 'different_identity' AND (eff_rival.targets = eff_own.targets OR eff_rival.targets = reverse(eff_own.targets)))
     OR ((eff_rival.operation = 'exclude_link' AND (eff_rival.link_kind IS NULL OR eff_rival.link_kind = 'same_as')) AND (eff_rival.targets = eff_own.targets OR eff_rival.targets = reverse(eff_own.targets)))
     OR (eff_rival.operation = 'split' AND (
           (eff_own.targets[0] = eff_rival.targets[0] AND eff_own.targets[1] IN eff_rival.targets[1..])
        OR (eff_own.targets[1] = eff_rival.targets[0] AND eff_own.targets[0] IN eff_rival.targets[1..])))))
  OR ((eff_own.operation = 'resolve_mention' OR (eff_own.operation = 'include_link' AND eff_own.link_kind = 'resolves_to')) AND (
        ((eff_rival.operation = 'resolve_mention' OR (eff_rival.operation = 'include_link' AND eff_rival.link_kind = 'resolves_to')) AND eff_rival.targets[0] = eff_own.targets[0] AND eff_rival.targets[1] <> eff_own.targets[1])
     OR (eff_rival.operation = 'unresolve_mention' AND eff_rival.targets[0] = eff_own.targets[0])
     OR (eff_rival.operation = 'different_identity' AND (eff_rival.targets = eff_own.targets OR eff_rival.targets = reverse(eff_own.targets)))
     OR ((eff_rival.operation = 'exclude_link' AND (eff_rival.link_kind IS NULL OR eff_rival.link_kind = 'resolves_to')) AND (eff_rival.targets = eff_own.targets OR eff_rival.targets = reverse(eff_own.targets)))
     OR (eff_rival.operation = 'split' AND eff_rival.targets[0] = eff_own.targets[1]
         AND eff_own.targets[0] IN eff_rival.targets[1..])))
  OR ((eff_own.operation = 'merge' OR (eff_own.operation = 'include_link' AND eff_own.link_kind = 'merged_into')) AND (
        (eff_rival.operation = 'split' AND eff_rival.targets[0] IN eff_own.targets
         AND any(part IN eff_rival.targets[1..] WHERE part IN eff_own.targets))
     OR (eff_rival.operation = 'different_identity' AND all(t IN eff_rival.targets WHERE t IN eff_own.targets))
     OR ((eff_rival.operation = 'merge' OR (eff_rival.operation = 'include_link' AND eff_rival.link_kind = 'merged_into')) AND (CASE WHEN eff_rival.operation = 'merge' THEN eff_rival.targets[0] ELSE eff_rival.targets[1] END) <> (CASE WHEN eff_own.operation = 'merge' THEN eff_own.targets[0] ELSE eff_own.targets[1] END)
         AND (any(t IN (CASE WHEN eff_own.operation = 'merge' THEN eff_own.targets[1..] ELSE eff_own.targets[0..1] END) WHERE t IN (CASE WHEN eff_rival.operation = 'merge' THEN eff_rival.targets[1..] ELSE eff_rival.targets[0..1] END))
              OR ((CASE WHEN eff_rival.operation = 'merge' THEN eff_rival.targets[0] ELSE eff_rival.targets[1] END) IN (CASE WHEN eff_own.operation = 'merge' THEN eff_own.targets[1..] ELSE eff_own.targets[0..1] END) AND (CASE WHEN eff_own.operation = 'merge' THEN eff_own.targets[0] ELSE eff_own.targets[1] END) IN (CASE WHEN eff_rival.operation = 'merge' THEN eff_rival.targets[1..] ELSE eff_rival.targets[0..1] END))))
     OR ((eff_rival.operation = 'exclude_link' AND (eff_rival.link_kind IS NULL OR eff_rival.link_kind = 'merged_into')) AND (CASE WHEN eff_own.operation = 'merge' THEN eff_own.targets[0] ELSE eff_own.targets[1] END) IN eff_rival.targets
         AND any(t IN (CASE WHEN eff_own.operation = 'merge' THEN eff_own.targets[1..] ELSE eff_own.targets[0..1] END) WHERE t IN eff_rival.targets))))) OR (
     (eff_rival.operation = 'include_link' AND (eff_own.operation = 'exclude_link' AND (eff_own.link_kind IS NULL OR eff_own.link_kind = eff_rival.link_kind)) AND (eff_own.targets = eff_rival.targets OR eff_own.targets = reverse(eff_rival.targets)))
  OR ((eff_rival.operation = 'same_identity' OR (eff_rival.operation = 'include_link' AND eff_rival.link_kind = 'same_as')) AND (
        (eff_own.operation = 'different_identity' AND (eff_own.targets = eff_rival.targets OR eff_own.targets = reverse(eff_rival.targets)))
     OR ((eff_own.operation = 'exclude_link' AND (eff_own.link_kind IS NULL OR eff_own.link_kind = 'same_as')) AND (eff_own.targets = eff_rival.targets OR eff_own.targets = reverse(eff_rival.targets)))
     OR (eff_own.operation = 'split' AND (
           (eff_rival.targets[0] = eff_own.targets[0] AND eff_rival.targets[1] IN eff_own.targets[1..])
        OR (eff_rival.targets[1] = eff_own.targets[0] AND eff_rival.targets[0] IN eff_own.targets[1..])))))
  OR ((eff_rival.operation = 'resolve_mention' OR (eff_rival.operation = 'include_link' AND eff_rival.link_kind = 'resolves_to')) AND (
        ((eff_own.operation = 'resolve_mention' OR (eff_own.operation = 'include_link' AND eff_own.link_kind = 'resolves_to')) AND eff_own.targets[0] = eff_rival.targets[0] AND eff_own.targets[1] <> eff_rival.targets[1])
     OR (eff_own.operation = 'unresolve_mention' AND eff_own.targets[0] = eff_rival.targets[0])
     OR (eff_own.operation = 'different_identity' AND (eff_own.targets = eff_rival.targets OR eff_own.targets = reverse(eff_rival.targets)))
     OR ((eff_own.operation = 'exclude_link' AND (eff_own.link_kind IS NULL OR eff_own.link_kind = 'resolves_to')) AND (eff_own.targets = eff_rival.targets OR eff_own.targets = reverse(eff_rival.targets)))
     OR (eff_own.operation = 'split' AND eff_own.targets[0] = eff_rival.targets[1]
         AND eff_rival.targets[0] IN eff_own.targets[1..])))
  OR ((eff_rival.operation = 'merge' OR (eff_rival.operation = 'include_link' AND eff_rival.link_kind = 'merged_into')) AND (
        (eff_own.operation = 'split' AND eff_own.targets[0] IN eff_rival.targets
         AND any(part IN eff_own.targets[1..] WHERE part IN eff_rival.targets))
     OR (eff_own.operation = 'different_identity' AND all(t IN eff_own.targets WHERE t IN eff_rival.targets))
     OR ((eff_own.operation = 'merge' OR (eff_own.operation = 'include_link' AND eff_own.link_kind = 'merged_into')) AND (CASE WHEN eff_own.operation = 'merge' THEN eff_own.targets[0] ELSE eff_own.targets[1] END) <> (CASE WHEN eff_rival.operation = 'merge' THEN eff_rival.targets[0] ELSE eff_rival.targets[1] END)
         AND (any(t IN (CASE WHEN eff_rival.operation = 'merge' THEN eff_rival.targets[1..] ELSE eff_rival.targets[0..1] END) WHERE t IN (CASE WHEN eff_own.operation = 'merge' THEN eff_own.targets[1..] ELSE eff_own.targets[0..1] END))
              OR ((CASE WHEN eff_own.operation = 'merge' THEN eff_own.targets[0] ELSE eff_own.targets[1] END) IN (CASE WHEN eff_rival.operation = 'merge' THEN eff_rival.targets[1..] ELSE eff_rival.targets[0..1] END) AND (CASE WHEN eff_rival.operation = 'merge' THEN eff_rival.targets[0] ELSE eff_rival.targets[1] END) IN (CASE WHEN eff_own.operation = 'merge' THEN eff_own.targets[1..] ELSE eff_own.targets[0..1] END))))
     OR ((eff_own.operation = 'exclude_link' AND (eff_own.link_kind IS NULL OR eff_own.link_kind = 'merged_into')) AND (CASE WHEN eff_rival.operation = 'merge' THEN eff_rival.targets[0] ELSE eff_rival.targets[1] END) IN eff_own.targets
         AND any(t IN (CASE WHEN eff_rival.operation = 'merge' THEN eff_rival.targets[1..] ELSE eff_rival.targets[0..1] END) WHERE t IN eff_own.targets))))))
         | {key: eff_own.id, all: eff_rival.all, docs: eff_rival.docs}]) AS eff_rivals
  CALL (eff_hides) {
    UNWIND eff_hides AS eff_h
    WITH eff_h.key AS eff_k, collect({all: eff_h.all, docs: eff_h.docs}) AS eff_s
    RETURN apoc.map.fromPairs(collect([eff_k, eff_s])) AS eff_hidden
  }
  CALL (eff_rivals) {
    UNWIND eff_rivals AS eff_h
    WITH eff_h.key AS eff_k, collect({all: eff_h.all, docs: eff_h.docs}) AS eff_s
    RETURN apoc.map.fromPairs(collect([eff_k, eff_s])) AS eff_contested
  }
  RETURN eff_hidden, eff_contested,
         apoc.map.fromPairs([eff_h IN eff_hides | [split(eff_h.key, '|')[0], true]])
           AS eff_hiding,
         apoc.map.fromPairs([eff_s IN eff_corrections
                             | [eff_s.id, [{all: eff_s.all, docs: eff_s.docs}]]]) AS eff_scopes
}
WITH {hidden: eff_hidden, hiding: eff_hiding, scopes: eff_scopes,
   contested: eff_contested, apart_links: {}} AS eff_view
CALL (eff_view) {
  OPTIONAL MATCH (eff_apart:PDCorrection {status: 'active'})
  WHERE eff_apart.operation = 'different_identity'
  OPTIONAL MATCH (eff_x:PDGraphNode {id: eff_apart.targets[0]})
  OPTIONAL MATCH (eff_y:PDGraphNode {id: eff_apart.targets[1]})
  OPTIONAL MATCH eff_left = (eff_x)(()-[eff_l:PD_RELATION WHERE eff_l.kind = 'merged_into' AND (((coalesce(eff_l.origin, "") <> "automatic" OR eff_l.stage = "interpretation")
  AND coalesce(eff_l.current, true)) AND coalesce(startNode(eff_l).current, true) AND coalesce(endNode(eff_l).current, true)
  AND (eff_l.correction_id IS NOT NULL OR NOT ((eff_view.hiding[startNode(eff_l).id] IS NOT NULL
   OR eff_view.hidden['doc|' + coalesce(eff_l.document_id, '')] IS NOT NULL)
  AND any(eff_key IN [startNode(eff_l).id + '|' + endNode(eff_l).id + '|' + coalesce(eff_l.kind, ''), startNode(eff_l).id + '|' + endNode(eff_l).id + '|*', CASE WHEN eff_l.kind = 'resolves_to' AND coalesce(eff_l.origin, '') = 'automatic' THEN startNode(eff_l).id + '|*|resolves_to|A' ELSE '' END, CASE WHEN eff_l.kind = 'resolves_to' AND coalesce(eff_l.origin, '') = 'automatic' THEN startNode(eff_l).id + '|' + endNode(eff_l).id + '|resolves_to|A' ELSE '' END, CASE WHEN coalesce(eff_l.origin, '') = 'automatic' THEN 'doc|' + coalesce(eff_l.document_id, '') ELSE '' END] WHERE
      any(eff_hide IN coalesce(eff_view.hidden[eff_key], [])
          WHERE (eff_hide.all OR any(eff_doc IN eff_hide.docs WHERE eff_doc IN [eff_id IN [eff_l.document_id, startNode(eff_l).id, endNode(eff_l).id, startNode(eff_l).document_id, endNode(eff_l).document_id] WHERE eff_id IS NOT NULL]))))))
  AND (eff_l.correction_id IS NULL OR (eff_l.correction_id IS NOT NULL
  AND any(eff_source IN coalesce(eff_view.scopes[coalesce(eff_l.correction_id, '')], [])
          WHERE (eff_source.all OR any(eff_doc IN eff_source.docs WHERE eff_doc IN [eff_id IN [eff_l.document_id, startNode(eff_l).id, endNode(eff_l).id, startNode(eff_l).document_id, endNode(eff_l).document_id] WHERE eff_id IS NOT NULL]))))))]->())*(eff_join:PDGraphNode)
  OPTIONAL MATCH eff_right = (eff_y)(()-[eff_r:PD_RELATION WHERE eff_r.kind = 'merged_into' AND (((coalesce(eff_r.origin, "") <> "automatic" OR eff_r.stage = "interpretation")
  AND coalesce(eff_r.current, true)) AND coalesce(startNode(eff_r).current, true) AND coalesce(endNode(eff_r).current, true)
  AND (eff_r.correction_id IS NOT NULL OR NOT ((eff_view.hiding[startNode(eff_r).id] IS NOT NULL
   OR eff_view.hidden['doc|' + coalesce(eff_r.document_id, '')] IS NOT NULL)
  AND any(eff_key IN [startNode(eff_r).id + '|' + endNode(eff_r).id + '|' + coalesce(eff_r.kind, ''), startNode(eff_r).id + '|' + endNode(eff_r).id + '|*', CASE WHEN eff_r.kind = 'resolves_to' AND coalesce(eff_r.origin, '') = 'automatic' THEN startNode(eff_r).id + '|*|resolves_to|A' ELSE '' END, CASE WHEN eff_r.kind = 'resolves_to' AND coalesce(eff_r.origin, '') = 'automatic' THEN startNode(eff_r).id + '|' + endNode(eff_r).id + '|resolves_to|A' ELSE '' END, CASE WHEN coalesce(eff_r.origin, '') = 'automatic' THEN 'doc|' + coalesce(eff_r.document_id, '') ELSE '' END] WHERE
      any(eff_hide IN coalesce(eff_view.hidden[eff_key], [])
          WHERE (eff_hide.all OR any(eff_doc IN eff_hide.docs WHERE eff_doc IN [eff_id IN [eff_r.document_id, startNode(eff_r).id, endNode(eff_r).id, startNode(eff_r).document_id, endNode(eff_r).document_id] WHERE eff_id IS NOT NULL]))))))
  AND (eff_r.correction_id IS NULL OR (eff_r.correction_id IS NOT NULL
  AND any(eff_source IN coalesce(eff_view.scopes[coalesce(eff_r.correction_id, '')], [])
          WHERE (eff_source.all OR any(eff_doc IN eff_source.docs WHERE eff_doc IN [eff_id IN [eff_r.document_id, startNode(eff_r).id, endNode(eff_r).id, startNode(eff_r).document_id, endNode(eff_r).document_id] WHERE eff_id IS NOT NULL]))))))]->())*(eff_join)
  WITH eff_apart, eff_left, eff_right
  WHERE eff_right IS NOT NULL
  WITH eff_apart, eff_left, eff_right,
       nodes(eff_left) + nodes(eff_right) AS eff_nodes,
       relationships(eff_left) + relationships(eff_right) AS eff_links
  WHERE (eff_apart.scope = ['all'] OR EXISTS {
      MATCH (eff_document:PDDocument)
      WHERE eff_document.current_version_id IN eff_apart.scope
        AND eff_document.id IN [eff_n IN eff_nodes | eff_n.id] + [eff_n IN eff_nodes | eff_n.document_id] + [eff_m IN eff_links | eff_m.document_id] })
  UNWIND relationships(eff_left) + relationships(eff_right) AS eff_link
  WITH DISTINCT eff_apart.id AS eff_apart_id, eff_link.id AS eff_link_id,
       eff_link.correction_id AS eff_merge_id
  RETURN collect([eff_apart_id, eff_link_id, eff_merge_id]) AS eff_apart_pairs
}
WITH eff_apart_pairs,
     {hidden: eff_view.hidden, hiding: eff_view.hiding, scopes: eff_view.scopes,
       contested: eff_view.contested,
       apart_links: apoc.map.fromPairs([eff_p IN eff_apart_pairs | [eff_p[1], true]])}
       AS eff_view


CALL () {
MATCH (eff_separation:PDCorrection {status: 'active', operation: 'different_identity'})
UNWIND [eff_separation.targets, reverse(eff_separation.targets)] AS eff_pair
WITH eff_pair[0] AS eff_first, eff_pair[1] AS eff_second,
     collect(eff_separation) AS eff_rules
WITH eff_first, apoc.map.fromPairs(collect([eff_second, eff_rules])) AS eff_targets
RETURN apoc.map.fromPairs(collect([eff_first, eff_targets])) AS eff_separations
}
CALL (eff_view) {
  CALL (eff_view) {
    MATCH (party:PDGraphNode:PDEntity)
    WHERE party.name_key IS NOT NULL AND coalesce(party.current, true)
      AND ($collection_ids IS NULL OR party:PDIdentity OR EXISTS {
        MATCH (:PDDocument {id: party.document_id})-[:MEMBER_OF]->(project:PDCollection)
        WHERE project.id IN $collection_ids })
      AND (party:PDIdentity OR EXISTS {
        MATCH (party)-[membership:PD_RELATION]-()
        WHERE ((((coalesce(membership.origin, "") <> "automatic" OR membership.stage = "interpretation")
  AND coalesce(membership.current, true)) AND coalesce(startNode(membership).current, true) AND coalesce(endNode(membership).current, true)
  AND (membership.correction_id IS NOT NULL OR NOT ((eff_view.hiding[startNode(membership).id] IS NOT NULL
   OR eff_view.hidden['doc|' + coalesce(membership.document_id, '')] IS NOT NULL)
  AND any(eff_key IN [startNode(membership).id + '|' + endNode(membership).id + '|' + coalesce(membership.kind, ''), startNode(membership).id + '|' + endNode(membership).id + '|*', CASE WHEN membership.kind = 'resolves_to' AND coalesce(membership.origin, '') = 'automatic' THEN startNode(membership).id + '|*|resolves_to|A' ELSE '' END, CASE WHEN membership.kind = 'resolves_to' AND coalesce(membership.origin, '') = 'automatic' THEN startNode(membership).id + '|' + endNode(membership).id + '|resolves_to|A' ELSE '' END, CASE WHEN coalesce(membership.origin, '') = 'automatic' THEN 'doc|' + coalesce(membership.document_id, '') ELSE '' END] WHERE
      any(eff_hide IN coalesce(eff_view.hidden[eff_key], [])
          WHERE (eff_hide.all OR any(eff_doc IN eff_hide.docs WHERE eff_doc IN [eff_id IN [membership.document_id, startNode(membership).id, endNode(membership).id, startNode(membership).document_id, endNode(membership).document_id] WHERE eff_id IS NOT NULL]))))))
  AND (membership.correction_id IS NULL OR (membership.correction_id IS NOT NULL
  AND any(eff_source IN coalesce(eff_view.scopes[coalesce(membership.correction_id, '')], [])
          WHERE (eff_source.all OR any(eff_doc IN eff_source.docs WHERE eff_doc IN [eff_id IN [membership.document_id, startNode(membership).id, endNode(membership).id, startNode(membership).document_id, endNode(membership).document_id] WHERE eff_id IS NOT NULL])))))) AND NOT (eff_view.apart_links[coalesce(membership.id, '')] IS NOT NULL
      OR (membership.correction_id IS NOT NULL
          AND any(eff_rival IN coalesce(eff_view.contested[coalesce(membership.correction_id, '')], [])
                  WHERE (eff_rival.all OR any(eff_doc IN eff_rival.docs WHERE eff_doc IN [eff_id IN [membership.document_id, startNode(membership).id, endNode(membership).id, startNode(membership).document_id, endNode(membership).document_id] WHERE eff_id IS NOT NULL])))))) })
    RETURN collect(party) AS parties
  }
  WITH parties, eff_view, [party IN parties WHERE NOT party:PDIdentity | party.id] AS mention_ids
  
WITH parties, eff_view, mention_ids, eff_view AS eff_state_view
CALL (mention_ids, eff_state_view) {
  CALL (mention_ids, eff_state_view) {
  WITH mention_ids, eff_state_view AS eff_view
  
CALL (mention_ids) {
  UNWIND mention_ids AS eff_mention_id
  MATCH (eff_mention:PDGraphNode {id: eff_mention_id})
  RETURN eff_mention.document_id AS eff_document_id, collect(eff_mention) AS eff_mentions
}
CALL (eff_mentions, eff_document_id, eff_view) {
  OPTIONAL MATCH (eff_apart:PDCorrection {status: 'active'})
  WHERE eff_apart.operation = 'different_identity'
  OPTIONAL MATCH (eff_x:PDGraphNode {id: eff_apart.targets[0]})
  OPTIONAL MATCH (eff_y:PDGraphNode {id: eff_apart.targets[1]})
  OPTIONAL MATCH eff_left = (eff_x)(()-[eff_l:PD_RELATION WHERE eff_l.kind = 'merged_into' AND (((coalesce(eff_l.origin, "") <> "automatic" OR eff_l.stage = "interpretation")
  AND coalesce(eff_l.current, true)) AND coalesce(startNode(eff_l).current, true) AND coalesce(endNode(eff_l).current, true)
  AND (eff_l.correction_id IS NOT NULL OR NOT ((eff_view.hiding[startNode(eff_l).id] IS NOT NULL
   OR eff_view.hidden['doc|' + coalesce(eff_l.document_id, '')] IS NOT NULL)
  AND any(eff_key IN [startNode(eff_l).id + '|' + endNode(eff_l).id + '|' + coalesce(eff_l.kind, ''), startNode(eff_l).id + '|' + endNode(eff_l).id + '|*', CASE WHEN eff_l.kind = 'resolves_to' AND coalesce(eff_l.origin, '') = 'automatic' THEN startNode(eff_l).id + '|*|resolves_to|A' ELSE '' END, CASE WHEN eff_l.kind = 'resolves_to' AND coalesce(eff_l.origin, '') = 'automatic' THEN startNode(eff_l).id + '|' + endNode(eff_l).id + '|resolves_to|A' ELSE '' END, CASE WHEN coalesce(eff_l.origin, '') = 'automatic' THEN 'doc|' + coalesce(eff_l.document_id, '') ELSE '' END] WHERE
      any(eff_hide IN coalesce(eff_view.hidden[eff_key], [])
          WHERE (eff_hide.all OR any(eff_doc IN eff_hide.docs WHERE eff_doc IN [eff_id IN [eff_l.document_id, startNode(eff_l).id, endNode(eff_l).id, startNode(eff_l).document_id, endNode(eff_l).document_id] + [eff_document_id] WHERE eff_id IS NOT NULL]))))))
  AND (eff_l.correction_id IS NULL OR (eff_l.correction_id IS NOT NULL
  AND any(eff_source IN coalesce(eff_view.scopes[coalesce(eff_l.correction_id, '')], [])
          WHERE (eff_source.all OR any(eff_doc IN eff_source.docs WHERE eff_doc IN [eff_id IN [eff_l.document_id, startNode(eff_l).id, endNode(eff_l).id, startNode(eff_l).document_id, endNode(eff_l).document_id] + [eff_document_id] WHERE eff_id IS NOT NULL]))))))]->())*(eff_join:PDGraphNode)
  OPTIONAL MATCH eff_right = (eff_y)(()-[eff_r:PD_RELATION WHERE eff_r.kind = 'merged_into' AND (((coalesce(eff_r.origin, "") <> "automatic" OR eff_r.stage = "interpretation")
  AND coalesce(eff_r.current, true)) AND coalesce(startNode(eff_r).current, true) AND coalesce(endNode(eff_r).current, true)

   OR eff_view.hidden['doc|' + coalesce(eff_r.document_id, '')] IS NOT NULL)

  AND any(eff_key IN [startNode(step).id + '|' + endNode(step).id + '|' + coalesce(step.kind, ''), startNode(step).id + '|' + endNode(step).id + '|*', CASE WHEN step.kind = 'resolves_to' AND coalesce(step.origin, '') = 'automatic' THEN startNode(step).id + '|*|resolves_to|A' ELSE '' END, CASE WHEN step.kind = 'resolves_to' AND coalesce(step.origin, '') = 'automatic' THEN startNode(step).id + '|' + endNode(step).id + '|resolves_to|A' ELSE '' END, CASE WHEN coalesce(step.origin, '') = 'automatic' THEN 'doc|' + coalesce(step.document_id, '') ELSE '' END] WHERE
      any(eff_hide IN coalesce(eff_view.hidden[eff_key], [])
          WHERE (eff_hide.all OR any(eff_doc IN eff_hide.docs WHERE eff_doc IN [eff_id IN [step.document_id, startNode(step).id, endNode(step).id, startNode(step).document_id, endNode(step).document_id] WHERE eff_id IS NOT NULL]))))))
  AND (step.correction_id IS NULL OR (step.correction_id IS NOT NULL
  AND any(eff_source IN coalesce(eff_view.scopes[coalesce(step.correction_id, '')], [])
          WHERE (eff_source.all OR any(eff_doc IN eff_source.docs WHERE eff_doc IN [eff_id IN [step.document_id, startNode(step).id, endNode(step).id, startNode(step).document_id, endNode(step).document_id] WHERE eff_id IS NOT NULL]))))))
  AND (eff_view.apart_links[coalesce(step.id, '')] IS NOT NULL
      OR (step.correction_id IS NOT NULL
          AND any(eff_rival IN coalesce(eff_view.contested[coalesce(step.correction_id, '')], [])
                  WHERE (eff_rival.all OR any(eff_doc IN eff_rival.docs WHERE eff_doc IN [eff_id IN [step.document_id, startNode(step).id, endNode(step).id, startNode(step).document_id, endNode(step).document_id] WHERE eff_id IS NOT NULL])))))
WITH eff_view, party, reached, terminal, count(step) > 0 AS step_disputed
WITH eff_view, party, collect(DISTINCT CASE WHEN terminal THEN reached.id END) AS terminals,
     max(CASE WHEN step_disputed THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 1 AS chain_disputed
WITH eff_view, party, CASE WHEN size(terminals) = 1 AND NOT chain_disputed THEN terminals[0] END AS survivor_id
OPTIONAL MATCH (survivor:PDGraphNode {id: survivor_id})
WITH eff_view, coalesce(survivor, party) AS party
WITH DISTINCT party, party:PDIdentity AS identity
  WITH party, identity,
       CASE WHEN identity THEN party.kind ELSE $classes[coalesce(party.definition_id, '')] END
         AS class
  UNWIND [at IN range(-1, size(coalesce(party.alias_keys, [])) - 1) WHERE at = -1 OR coalesce(party.alias_types[at], '') <> $rejected | CASE WHEN at = -1 THEN party.name_key ELSE party.alias_keys[at] END] AS name
  WITH party, identity, class, apoc.text.join([word IN split(string.regexReplace(toLower(name), '[^\\p{L}\\p{N}]+', ' '), ' ') WHERE word <> '' | CASE word WHEN 'limited' THEN 'ltd' WHEN 'incorporated' THEN 'inc' WHEN 'corporation' THEN 'corp' ELSE word END], ' ') AS key
  WHERE key <> ''
  WITH key, collect(DISTINCT {party: party, identity: identity, class: class}) AS named
  WITH key, named, apoc.coll.toSet([each IN named WHERE each.class IN $class_names
                                   | each.class]) AS classes
  UNWIND CASE WHEN size(classes) = 0 THEN [''] ELSE classes END AS class
  WITH key, class, [each IN named WHERE class = '' OR each.class IS NULL
                     OR NOT each.class IN $class_names OR each.class = class] AS named
  WHERE size(named) > 1
  RETURN collect({key: class + '|' + key, name_key: key, class: class, named: named}) AS groups
}
CALL (eff_view, eff_separations) {
  WITH eff_view, eff_separations WHERE size(keys(eff_separations)) > 0
  MATCH (merged_node:PDGraphNode)-[merge_out:PD_RELATION]->(:PDGraphNode)
  WHERE merge_out.kind = 'merged_into'
  WITH DISTINCT merged_node, merged_node.id AS raw_id, eff_view
  OPTIONAL MATCH (merged_node)(()-[merged:PD_RELATION
    WHERE merged.kind = 'merged_into' AND (((coalesce(merged.origin, "") <> "automatic" OR merged.stage = "interpretation")
  AND coalesce(merged.current, true)) AND coalesce(startNode(merged).current, true) AND coalesce(endNode(merged).current, true)
  AND (merged.correction_id IS NOT NULL OR NOT ((eff_view.hiding[startNode(merged).id] IS NOT NULL
   OR eff_view.hidden['doc|' + coalesce(merged.document_id, '')] IS NOT NULL)
  AND any(eff_key IN [startNode(merged).id + '|' + endNode(merged).id + '|' + coalesce(merged.kind, ''), startNode(merged).id + '|' + endNode(merged).id + '|*', CASE WHEN merged.kind = 'resolves_to' AND coalesce(merged.origin, '') = 'automatic' THEN startNode(merged).id + '|*|resolves_to|A' ELSE '' END, CASE WHEN merged.kind = 'resolves_to' AND coalesce(merged.origin, '') = 'automatic' THEN startNode(merged).id + '|' + endNode(merged).id + '|resolves_to|A' ELSE '' END, CASE WHEN coalesce(merged.origin, '') = 'automatic' THEN 'doc|' + coalesce(merged.document_id, '') ELSE '' END] WHERE
      any(eff_hide IN coalesce(eff_view.hidden[eff_key], [])
          WHERE (eff_hide.all OR any(eff_doc IN eff_hide.docs WHERE eff_doc IN [eff_id IN [merged.document_id, startNode(merged).id, endNode(merged).id, startNode(merged).document_id, endNode(merged).document_id] WHERE eff_id IS NOT NULL]))))))
  AND (merged.correction_id IS NULL OR (merged.correction_id IS NOT NULL
  AND any(eff_source IN coalesce(eff_view.scopes[coalesce(merged.correction_id, '')], [])
          WHERE (eff_source.all OR any(eff_doc IN eff_source.docs WHERE eff_doc IN [eff_id IN [merged.document_id, startNode(merged).id, endNode(merged).id, startNode(merged).document_id, endNode(merged).document_id] WHERE eff_id IS NOT NULL]))))))]->())*
    (reached:PDGraphNode)
OPTIONAL MATCH (reached)-[next:PD_RELATION]->()
WHERE next.kind = 'merged_into' AND (((coalesce(next.origin, "") <> "automatic" OR next.stage = "interpretation")
  AND coalesce(next.current, true)) AND coalesce(startNode(next).current, true) AND coalesce(endNode(next).current, true)
  AND (next.correction_id IS NOT NULL OR NOT ((eff_view.hiding[startNode(next).id] IS NOT NULL
   OR eff_view.hidden['doc|' + coalesce(next.document_id, '')] IS NOT NULL)
  AND any(eff_key IN [startNode(next).id + '|' + endNode(next).id + '|' + coalesce(next.kind, ''), startNode(next).id + '|' + endNode(next).id + '|*', CASE WHEN next.kind = 'resolves_to' AND coalesce(next.origin, '') = 'automatic' THEN startNode(next).id + '|*|resolves_to|A' ELSE '' END, CASE WHEN next.kind = 'resolves_to' AND coalesce(next.origin, '') = 'automatic' THEN startNode(next).id + '|' + endNode(next).id + '|resolves_to|A' ELSE '' END, CASE WHEN coalesce(next.origin, '') = 'automatic' THEN 'doc|' + coalesce(next.document_id, '') ELSE '' END] WHERE
      any(eff_hide IN coalesce(eff_view.hidden[eff_key], [])
          WHERE (eff_hide.all OR any(eff_doc IN eff_hide.docs WHERE eff_doc IN [eff_id IN [next.document_id, startNode(next).id, endNode(next).id, startNode(next).document_id, endNode(next).document_id] WHERE eff_id IS NOT NULL]))))))
  AND (next.correction_id IS NULL OR (next.correction_id IS NOT NULL
  AND any(eff_source IN coalesce(eff_view.scopes[coalesce(next.correction_id, '')], [])
          WHERE (eff_source.all OR any(eff_doc IN eff_source.docs WHERE eff_doc IN [eff_id IN [next.document_id, startNode(next).id, endNode(next).id, startNode(next).document_id, endNode(next).document_id] WHERE eff_id IS NOT NULL]))))))
WITH raw_id, eff_view, merged_node, reached, count(next) = 0 AS terminal
OPTIONAL MATCH (reached)-[step:PD_RELATION]->()
WHERE step.kind = 'merged_into' AND (((coalesce(step.origin, "") <> "automatic" OR step.stage = "interpretation")
  AND coalesce(step.current, true)) AND coalesce(startNode(step).current, true) AND coalesce(endNode(step).current, true)
  AND (step.correction_id IS NOT NULL OR NOT ((eff_view.hiding[startNode(step).id] IS NOT NULL
   OR eff_view.hidden['doc|' + coalesce(step.document_id, '')] IS NOT NULL)
  AND any(eff_key IN [startNode(step).id + '|' + endNode(step).id + '|' + coalesce(step.kind, ''), startNode(step).id + '|' + endNode(step).id + '|*', CASE WHEN step.kind = 'resolves_to' AND coalesce(step.origin, '') = 'automatic' THEN startNode(step).id + '|*|resolves_to|A' ELSE '' END, CASE WHEN step.kind = 'resolves_to' AND coalesce(step.origin, '') = 'automatic' THEN startNode(step).id + '|' + endNode(step).id + '|resolves_to|A' ELSE '' END, CASE WHEN coalesce(step.origin, '') = 'automatic' THEN 'doc|' + coalesce(step.document_id, '') ELSE '' END] WHERE
      any(eff_hide IN coalesce(eff_view.hidden[eff_key], [])
          WHERE (eff_hide.all OR any(eff_doc IN eff_hide.docs WHERE eff_doc IN [eff_id IN [step.document_id, startNode(step).id, endNode(step).id, startNode(step).document_id, endNode(step).document_id] WHERE eff_id IS NOT NULL]))))))
  AND (step.correction_id IS NULL OR (step.correction_id IS NOT NULL
  AND any(eff_source IN coalesce(eff_view.scopes[coalesce(step.correction_id, '')], [])
          WHERE (eff_source.all OR any(eff_doc IN eff_source.docs WHERE eff_doc IN [eff_id IN [step.document_id, startNode(step).id, endNode(step).id, startNode(step).document_id, endNode(step).document_id] WHERE eff_id IS NOT NULL]))))))
  AND (eff_view.apart_links[coalesce(step.id, '')] IS NOT NULL
      OR (step.correction_id IS NOT NULL
          AND any(eff_rival IN coalesce(eff_view.contested[coalesce(step.correction_id, '')], [])
                  WHERE (eff_rival.all OR any(eff_doc IN eff_rival.docs WHERE eff_doc IN [eff_id IN [step.document_id, startNode(step).id, endNode(step).id, startNode(step).document_id, endNode(step).document_id] WHERE eff_id IS NOT NULL])))))
WITH raw_id, eff_view, merged_node, reached, terminal, count(step) > 0 AS step_disputed
WITH raw_id, eff_view, merged_node, collect(DISTINCT CASE WHEN terminal THEN reached.id END) AS terminals,
     max(CASE WHEN step_disputed THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 1 AS chain_disputed
WITH raw_id, eff_view, merged_node, CASE WHEN size(terminals) = 1 AND NOT chain_disputed THEN terminals[0] END AS survivor_id
OPTIONAL MATCH (survivor:PDGraphNode {id: survivor_id})
WITH raw_id, eff_view, coalesce(survivor, merged_node) AS merged_node
WITH raw_id WHERE merged_node.id <> raw_id
  RETURN apoc.map.fromPairs(collect([raw_id, true])) AS settled
}
CALL (groups, eff_separations, eff_view, settled) {
  UNWIND groups AS named
  WITH named, eff_separations, eff_view, settled,
       apoc.map.fromPairs([each IN named.named | [each.party.id, each.party]]) AS members
  CALL (named, members, eff_separations) {
    UNWIND named.named AS each
    WITH each.party AS a, members, eff_separations
    UNWIND keys(coalesce(eff_separations[a.id], {})) AS other
    WITH a, members[other] AS b, eff_separations WHERE a.id < other AND b IS NOT NULL
    WITH a, b, eff_separations
    WHERE any(eff_separation IN coalesce(eff_separations[a.id][b.id], [])
  WHERE (eff_separation.targets = [a.id, b.id] OR eff_separation.targets = [b.id, a.id])
    AND (eff_separation.scope = ['all'] OR EXISTS {
      MATCH (eff_document:PDDocument)
      WHERE eff_document.current_version_id IN eff_separation.scope
        AND eff_document.id IN [a.id, b.id, a.document_id, b.document_id] }))
    WITH a, b ORDER BY a.id, b.id
    RETURN collect({a: a.id, b: b.id}) AS separations
  }
  WITH named, members, separations, eff_view, settled,
       apoc.map.fromPairs(reduce(pairs = [], each IN separations
                                 | pairs + [[each.a, true], [each.b, true]])) AS constrained
  CALL (named, members, constrained, eff_view, settled) {
    UNWIND named.named AS each
    WITH each.party AS anchor, members, constrained, eff_view, settled
    WHERE constrained[anchor.id] IS NOT NULL
    MATCH tied_path = SHORTEST 1 (anchor)(()-[tie:PD_RELATION
      WHERE tie.kind IN ['same_as', 'merged_into'] AND ((((coalesce(tie.origin, "") <> "automatic" OR tie.stage = "interpretation")
  AND coalesce(tie.current, true)) AND coalesce(startNode(tie).current, true) AND coalesce(endNode(tie).current, true)
  AND (tie.correction_id IS NOT NULL OR NOT ((eff_view.hiding[startNode(tie).id] IS NOT NULL
   OR eff_view.hidden['doc|' + coalesce(tie.document_id, '')] IS NOT NULL)
  AND any(eff_key IN [startNode(tie).id + '|' + endNode(tie).id + '|' + coalesce(tie.kind, ''), startNode(tie).id + '|' + endNode(tie).id + '|*', CASE WHEN tie.kind = 'resolves_to' AND coalesce(tie.origin, '') = 'automatic' THEN startNode(tie).id + '|*|resolves_to|A' ELSE '' END, CASE WHEN tie.kind = 'resolves_to' AND coalesce(tie.origin, '') = 'automatic' THEN startNode(tie).id + '|' + endNode(tie).id + '|resolves_to|A' ELSE '' END, CASE WHEN coalesce(tie.origin, '') = 'automatic' THEN 'doc|' + coalesce(tie.document_id, '') ELSE '' END] WHERE
      any(eff_hide IN coalesce(eff_view.hidden[eff_key], [])
          WHERE (eff_hide.all OR any(eff_doc IN eff_hide.docs WHERE eff_doc IN [eff_id IN [tie.document_id, startNode(tie).id, endNode(tie).id, startNode(tie).document_id, endNode(tie).document_id] WHERE eff_id IS NOT NULL]))))))
  AND (tie.correction_id IS NULL OR (tie.correction_id IS NOT NULL
  AND any(eff_source IN coalesce(eff_view.scopes[coalesce(tie.correction_id, '')], [])
          WHERE (eff_source.all OR any(eff_doc IN eff_source.docs WHERE eff_doc IN [eff_id IN [tie.document_id, startNode(tie).id, endNode(tie).id, startNode(tie).document_id, endNode(tie).document_id] WHERE eff_id IS NOT NULL])))))) AND NOT (eff_view.apart_links[coalesce(tie.id, '')] IS NOT NULL
      OR (tie.correction_id IS NOT NULL
          AND any(eff_rival IN coalesce(eff_view.contested[coalesce(tie.correction_id, '')], [])
                  WHERE (eff_rival.all OR any(eff_doc IN eff_rival.docs WHERE eff_doc IN [eff_id IN [tie.document_id, startNode(tie).id, endNode(tie).id, startNode(tie).document_id, endNode(tie).document_id] WHERE eff_id IS NOT NULL]))))))
        AND (tie.kind = 'same_as' OR settled[startNode(tie).id] IS NOT NULL)]-())*
      (tied:PDGraphNode)
    WITH anchor, members, tied WHERE members[tied.id] IS NOT NULL
    WITH anchor, apoc.coll.sort(collect(DISTINCT tied.id)) AS cohort
    WITH DISTINCT cohort
    WITH cohort ORDER BY cohort[0]
    RETURN collect({key: cohort[0], members: cohort}) AS anchors
  }
  RETURN collect({key: named.key, name_key: named.name_key, class: named.class,
                   named: named.named, member_index: members,
                   separations: separations, anchors: anchors})
         AS structured
}
CALL (eff_view, groups) {
  UNWIND groups AS named
  UNWIND named.named AS each
  WITH DISTINCT eff_view, each.party AS party, each.identity AS identity
  CALL (party, identity, eff_view) {
    WITH party, identity WHERE NOT identity
    RETURN party.document_id AS document_id
    UNION
    WITH party, identity WHERE identity
    CALL (party) {
  MATCH (held_holder_record:PDHeld {thing_id: party.id})
  MATCH (holder:PDDocument)-[has:PD_HAS]->(held_holder_record)
  RETURN holder
}
    RETURN holder.id AS document_id
  }
  WITH party.id AS party_id, identity, collect(DISTINCT document_id) AS documents
  RETURN apoc.map.fromPairs(collect([party_id, documents])) AS documents_of,
         apoc.map.fromPairs(collect(CASE WHEN identity THEN [party_id, size(documents)] END))
           AS identity_having
}
CALL (documents_of) {
  CALL (documents_of) {
    UNWIND keys(documents_of) AS party_id
    UNWIND documents_of[party_id] AS document_id
    MATCH (document:PDDocument {id: document_id})
    RETURN collect(DISTINCT document) AS documents
  }
  CALL (documents) {
  CALL (documents) {
  UNWIND documents AS document
  MATCH (document)-[has:PD_HAS]->(held:PDHeld)
  MATCH (thing:PDGraphNode {id: held.thing_id})
  RETURN document, thing, {link: has.link, item: has.item, kind: has.kind, source_id: has.source_id, cite_start: has.cite_start, cite_end: has.cite_end} AS via, held.holders AS having
}
  RETURN collect({document: document, thing: thing, via: via, having: having}) AS held
}
  UNWIND held AS each
  WITH each.document.id AS document_id,
       collect({thing: each.thing, having: each.having, via: each.via}) AS things
  RETURN apoc.map.fromPairs(collect([document_id, things])) AS things_of
}
CALL (documents_of, things_of) {
  UNWIND keys(documents_of) AS party_id
  UNWIND documents_of[party_id] AS document_id
  UNWIND coalesce(things_of[document_id], []) AS held
  WITH party_id, held.thing AS thing, held.having AS having, head(collect(held.via)) AS via
  WITH party_id, collect({thing: thing, having: having, via: via}) AS things
  RETURN apoc.map.fromPairs(collect([party_id, things])) AS party_things
}
CALL (structured, documents_of, things_of) {
  UNWIND structured AS named
  WITH named, documents_of, things_of,
       apoc.map.fromPairs([each IN named.named | [each.party.id, true]]) AS members
  CALL (named, documents_of) {
    UNWIND named.named AS each
    UNWIND coalesce(documents_of[each.party.id], []) AS document_id
    WITH DISTINCT document_id ORDER BY document_id
    RETURN collect(document_id) AS documents
  }
  CALL (documents, things_of, members) {
    UNWIND documents AS document_id
    UNWIND coalesce(things_of[document_id], []) AS held
    WITH document_id, held WHERE members[held.thing.id] IS NULL AND held.having > 0
    WITH held.thing AS thing, held.having AS having, count(*) AS in_item,
         head(collect({document_id: document_id, via: held.via})) AS example
    WHERE in_item > 1
    WITH thing, having, in_item, example ORDER BY having, thing.id
    RETURN collect({thing: thing, having: having, in_item: in_item,
                    document_id: example.document_id, via: example.via}) AS shared
  }
  CALL (named) {
    UNWIND named.named AS each
    UNWIND apoc.coll.toSet(coalesce(each.party.identifier_keys, [])) AS identifier
    WITH identifier, collect(each.party.id) AS members
    WITH identifier, members ORDER BY size(members) DESC, identifier
    RETURN collect({key: identifier, members: members, member_count: size(members)}) AS stated
  }
  CALL (stated) {
    UNWIND stated AS each
    WITH split(each.key, '\u001F')[0] AS scheme, each.key AS key ORDER BY key
    WITH scheme, collect(key) AS keys WHERE size(keys) > 1
    WITH scheme, keys ORDER BY scheme
    RETURN collect({scheme: scheme, keys: keys, key_count: size(keys)}) AS conflicts
  }
  RETURN collect({group: named, documents: documents, shared: shared,
                  identifiers: [each IN stated WHERE each.member_count > 1],
                  conflicts: conflicts}) AS evidenced
}
CALL (evidenced) {
  UNWIND evidenced AS item
  UNWIND item.shared AS held
  
  WITH item.group.key AS score_key, held WHERE held.having > 0
  WITH DISTINCT score_key, held.thing AS thing, held.having AS having
  WITH score_key, thing, having ORDER BY having, thing.id
  WITH score_key, collect(1.0 / having) AS weights
  RETURN apoc.map.fromPairs(collect([score_key, reduce(total = 0.0, weight IN weights | total + weight)])) AS score_of

}
WITH evidenced, party_things, documents_of, score_of,
     [item IN evidenced | {item: item, score: coalesce(score_of[item.group.key], 0.0)}] AS scored
CALL (scored) {
  UNWIND scored AS each
  WITH each ORDER BY size(each.item.identifiers) DESC, each.score DESC, each.item.group.key
  RETURN collect(each) AS ranked
}
WITH ranked, size(ranked) AS reached, party_things, documents_of,
     apoc.map.fromPairs([each IN ranked | [each.item.group.key, each.score]]) AS scores
WITH ranked[0..$limit] AS selected, reached, party_things, documents_of, scores
WITH reached, party_things, documents_of, scores, [each IN selected | each.item] AS evidenced
CALL (evidenced, party_things) {
  UNWIND evidenced AS item
  WITH item, party_things,
       CASE WHEN size(item.group.separations) = 0
            THEN [{key: item.group.key, members: [each IN item.group.named | each.party.id]}]
            ELSE item.group.anchors END AS parts
  CALL (item, parts, party_things) {
    UNWIND parts AS part
    CALL (item, part, party_things) {
      UNWIND CASE WHEN size(item.group.separations) = 0 THEN [] ELSE part.members END AS member
      UNWIND coalesce(party_things[member], []) AS held
      RETURN apoc.map.fromPairs(collect([held.thing.id, true])) AS things
    }
    CALL (item, part) {
      UNWIND CASE WHEN size(item.group.separations) = 0 THEN [] ELSE part.members END AS member
      UNWIND coalesce(item.group.member_index[member].identifier_keys, []) AS identifier
      RETURN apoc.map.fromPairs(collect([identifier, true])) AS identifiers
    }
    WITH part, things, identifiers ORDER BY part.key
    RETURN collect({key: part.key, members: part.members,
                    things: things, identifiers: identifiers}) AS subparties
  }
  WITH item, subparties,
       apoc.map.fromPairs(reduce(pairs = [], part IN subparties
                                 | pairs + [member IN part.members | [member, true]])) AS anchored
  RETURN collect({item: item, subparties: subparties,
                  candidates: [each IN item.group.named
                               WHERE anchored[each.party.id] IS NULL | each.party]})
         AS reviews
}
CALL (reviews, party_things) {
  UNWIND reviews AS review
  CALL (review, party_things) {
    UNWIND review.candidates AS candidate
    UNWIND review.subparties AS subparty
    WITH candidate, subparty, review,
         [held IN coalesce(party_things[candidate.id], [])
          WHERE subparty.things[held.thing.id] IS NOT NULL
            AND review.item.group.member_index[held.thing.id] IS NULL] AS shared
    WITH candidate, subparty, shared,
         apoc.coll.sort(apoc.coll.toSet([key IN coalesce(candidate.identifier_keys, [])
                         WHERE subparty.identifiers[key] IS NOT NULL])) AS identifiers
    WITH candidate, subparty, shared, identifiers,
         candidate.id + '|' + subparty.key AS key
    RETURN collect({key: key, candidate: candidate, subparty: subparty.key,
                     shared: shared, identifiers: identifiers}) AS affinities
  }
  CALL (affinities) {
    UNWIND affinities AS each
    UNWIND each.shared AS held
    
  WITH each.key AS score_key, held WHERE held.having > 0
  WITH DISTINCT score_key, held.thing AS thing, held.having AS having
  WITH score_key, thing, having ORDER BY having, thing.id
  WITH score_key, collect(1.0 / having) AS weights
  RETURN apoc.map.fromPairs(collect([score_key, reduce(total = 0.0, weight IN weights | total + weight)])) AS score_of

  }
  CALL (affinities, score_of) {
    UNWIND affinities AS each
    CALL (each) {
      UNWIND each.shared AS held
      WITH held ORDER BY held.having, held.thing.id
      RETURN collect({id: held.thing.id,
        name: coalesce(held.thing.name, held.thing.title, held.thing.label, held.thing.id),
        labels: labels(held.thing), weight: 1.0 / held.having, documents: held.having,
        via: held.via}) AS shared
    }
    WITH each, shared, coalesce(score_of[each.key], 0.0) AS score
      ORDER BY size(each.identifiers) DESC, score DESC, each.subparty
    WITH each.candidate AS member,
         collect({subparty: each.subparty, identifiers: each.identifiers[0..$per_item],
                   identifier_count: size(each.identifiers), shared: shared[0..$per_item],
                   shared_count: size(shared), score: score}) AS toward,
         max(size(each.identifiers)) AS strongest_identifiers, max(score) AS strongest_score
    WITH member, toward ORDER BY strongest_identifiers DESC, strongest_score DESC, member.id
    RETURN collect({member: member, toward: toward}) AS candidates
  }
  RETURN collect({review: review, candidates: candidates}) AS ready
}
CALL (ready, scores) {
  UNWIND ready AS each
  WITH each, each.review.item AS item,
       scores[each.review.item.group.key] AS score
  CALL (item) {
    UNWIND item.group.named AS member
    WITH member ORDER BY size(coalesce(member.party.identifier_keys, [])) DESC, member.party.id
    RETURN collect(member) AS members
  }
  WITH each, item, score, members ORDER BY size(item.identifiers) DESC, score DESC, item.group.key
  RETURN collect({key: item.group.key, name_key: item.group.name_key, class: item.group.class,
    names: apoc.coll.sort(apoc.coll.toSet([m IN members | coalesce(m.party.name, m.party.name_key)])),
    members: [m IN members | m.party.id], member_count: size(members),
    mention_count: size([m IN members WHERE NOT m.identity]),
    identity_count: size([m IN members WHERE m.identity]),
    mentions: [m IN members WHERE NOT m.identity | m.party][0..$per_item],
    identities: [m IN members WHERE m.identity | m.party][0..$per_item],
    mention_document_count: size(apoc.coll.toSet([m IN members WHERE NOT m.identity
                                                 | m.party.document_id])),
    mention_documents: apoc.coll.sort(apoc.coll.toSet([m IN members WHERE NOT m.identity
                                                     | m.party.document_id]))[0..$per_item],
    document_count: size(item.documents), documents: item.documents[0..$per_item],
    identifiers: [id IN item.identifiers[0..$per_item] |
      {key: id.key, member_count: id.member_count,
        members: apoc.coll.sort(id.members)[0..$per_item]}],
    identifier_count: size(item.identifiers),
    shared: [held IN item.shared[0..$per_item] |
      {id: held.thing.id,
        name: coalesce(held.thing.name, held.thing.title, held.thing.label, held.thing.id),
        labels: labels(held.thing), weight: 1.0 / held.having, documents: held.having,
        in_item: held.in_item, document_id: held.document_id, via: held.via}],
    shared_count: size(item.shared), score: score,
    conflicts: [c IN item.conflicts[0..$per_item] |
      {scheme: c.scheme, keys: c.keys[0..$per_item], key_count: c.key_count}],
    conflict_count: size(item.conflicts), kept_apart: item.group.separations,
    subparties: [part IN each.review.subparties |
      {key: part.key, members: apoc.coll.sort(part.members)}],
    candidate_members: apoc.coll.sort([c IN each.review.candidates | c.id]),
    candidate_count: size(each.review.candidates), candidates: each.candidates[0..$per_item]})
    AS items
}
CALL () {
  OPTIONAL MATCH (holdings_state:PDFreshness {id: 'holdings'})
  OPTIONAL MATCH (catch_up:PDFreshness {id: 'catch-up'})
  WITH coalesce(holdings_state.built, false) = true AS built,
       holdings_state.updating_since IS NOT NULL AS spread, catch_up.read_through AS read_through
  RETURN NOT built AS building, built AND spread AS updating,
         CASE WHEN built THEN read_through END AS as_of
}
RETURN building, updating, as_of, items, reached, reached > $limit AS capped

cases.name: walk_doc_d4
cases.statement:
OPTIONAL MATCH (node:PDGraphNode {id: $start_id})
OPTIONAL MATCH (hit:PDSearchSource {id: $start_id})
OPTIONAL MATCH (hit_document:PDDocument {id: hit.document_id})
WITH coalesce(node, hit_document) AS start
WHERE start IS NOT NULL

OPTIONAL MATCH (member:PDDocument)-[:MEMBER_OF]->(project:PDCollection)
WHERE $collection_ids IS NOT NULL AND project.id IN $collection_ids
WITH start, collect(DISTINCT member.id) AS scope_ids
CALL () {
  OPTIONAL MATCH (eff_c:PDCorrection {status: 'active'})
  OPTIONAL MATCH (eff_c)-[:CORRECTS]->(eff_t)
  WITH eff_c, collect(eff_t.id) AS eff_named
  OPTIONAL MATCH (eff_d:PDDocument) WHERE eff_d.current_version_id IN coalesce(eff_c.scope, [])
  WITH eff_c, eff_named, collect(eff_d.id) AS eff_docs
  WITH collect(CASE WHEN eff_c IS NULL THEN null
                    ELSE eff_c {.*, named: eff_named, docs: eff_docs,
                                all: eff_c.scope = ['all']} END) AS eff_corrections
  WITH eff_corrections,
       reduce(eff_all = [], eff_one IN eff_corrections | eff_all + (CASE
    WHEN eff_one.operation = 'exclude_link'
      THEN [eff_p IN [[eff_one.targets[0], eff_one.targets[1]],
                      [eff_one.targets[1], eff_one.targets[0]]] WHERE eff_p[0] IN eff_one.named
            | {key: eff_p[0] + '|' + eff_p[1] + '|' + coalesce(eff_one.link_kind, '*'),
               all: eff_one.all, docs: eff_one.docs}]
    WHEN eff_one.operation IN ['resolve_mention', 'unresolve_mention']
         OR (eff_one.operation = 'include_link' AND eff_one.link_kind = 'resolves_to')
      THEN [eff_m IN eff_one.targets[0..1] WHERE eff_m IN eff_one.named
            | {key: eff_m + '|*|resolves_to|A', all: eff_one.all, docs: eff_one.docs}]
    WHEN eff_one.operation = 'different_identity'
      THEN [eff_p IN [[eff_one.targets[0], eff_one.targets[1]],
                      [eff_one.targets[1], eff_one.targets[0]]] WHERE eff_p[0] IN eff_one.named
            | {key: eff_p[0] + '|' + eff_p[1] + '|resolves_to|A',
               all: eff_one.all, docs: eff_one.docs}]
    WHEN eff_one.operation = 'split'
      THEN [eff_m IN eff_one.targets[1..] WHERE eff_m IN eff_one.named
            | {key: eff_m + '|' + eff_one.targets[0] + '|resolves_to|A',
               all: eff_one.all, docs: eff_one.docs}]
    WHEN eff_one.operation = 'replace_interpretation' AND size(eff_one.targets) = 1
         AND eff_one.targets[0] IN eff_one.named
      THEN [{key: 'doc|' + eff_one.targets[0], all: eff_one.all, docs: eff_one.docs}]
    ELSE [] END)) AS eff_hides,
       reduce(eff_all = [], eff_own IN eff_corrections | eff_all + [eff_rival IN eff_corrections
         WHERE eff_rival.id <> eff_own.id
           AND any(eff_shared IN eff_rival.named WHERE eff_shared IN eff_own.targets)
           AND ((
     (eff_own.operation = 'include_link' AND (eff_rival.operation = 'exclude_link' AND (eff_rival.link_kind IS NULL OR eff_rival.link_kind = eff_own.link_kind)) AND (eff_rival.targets = eff_own.targets OR eff_rival.targets = reverse(eff_own.targets)))
  OR ((eff_own.operation = 'same_identity' OR (eff_own.operation = 'include_link' AND eff_own.link_kind = 'same_as')) AND (
        (eff_rival.operation = 'different_identity' AND (eff_rival.targets = eff_own.targets OR eff_rival.targets = reverse(eff_own.targets)))
     OR ((eff_rival.operation = 'exclude_link' AND (eff_rival.link_kind IS NULL OR eff_rival.link_kind = 'same_as')) AND (eff_rival.targets = eff_own.targets OR eff_rival.targets = reverse(eff_own.targets)))
     OR (eff_rival.operation = 'split' AND (
           (eff_own.targets[0] = eff_rival.targets[0] AND eff_own.targets[1] IN eff_rival.targets[1..])
        OR (eff_own.targets[1] = eff_rival.targets[0] AND eff_own.targets[0] IN eff_rival.targets[1..])))))
  OR ((eff_own.operation = 'resolve_mention' OR (eff_own.operation = 'include_link' AND eff_own.link_kind = 'resolves_to')) AND (
        ((eff_rival.operation = 'resolve_mention' OR (eff_rival.operation = 'include_link' AND eff_rival.link_kind = 'resolves_to')) AND eff_rival.targets[0] = eff_own.targets[0] AND eff_rival.targets[1] <> eff_own.targets[1])
     OR (eff_rival.operation = 'unresolve_mention' AND eff_rival.targets[0] = eff_own.targets[0])
     OR (eff_rival.operation = 'different_identity' AND (eff_rival.targets = eff_own.targets OR eff_rival.targets = reverse(eff_own.targets)))
     OR ((eff_rival.operation = 'exclude_link' AND (eff_rival.link_kind IS NULL OR eff_rival.link_kind = 'resolves_to')) AND (eff_rival.targets = eff_own.targets OR eff_rival.targets = reverse(eff_own.targets)))
     OR (eff_rival.operation = 'split' AND eff_rival.targets[0] = eff_own.targets[1]
         AND eff_own.targets[0] IN eff_rival.targets[1..])))
  OR ((eff_own.operation = 'merge' OR (eff_own.operation = 'include_link' AND eff_own.link_kind = 'merged_into')) AND (
        (eff_rival.operation = 'split' AND eff_rival.targets[0] IN eff_own.targets
         AND any(part IN eff_rival.targets[1..] WHERE part IN eff_own.targets))
     OR (eff_rival.operation = 'different_identity' AND all(t IN eff_rival.targets WHERE t IN eff_own.targets))
     OR ((eff_rival.operation = 'merge' OR (eff_rival.operation = 'include_link' AND eff_rival.link_kind = 'merged_into')) AND (CASE WHEN eff_rival.operation = 'merge' THEN eff_rival.targets[0] ELSE eff_rival.targets[1] END) <> (CASE WHEN eff_own.operation = 'merge' THEN eff_own.targets[0] ELSE eff_own.targets[1] END)
         AND (any(t IN (CASE WHEN eff_own.operation = 'merge' THEN eff_own.targets[1..] ELSE eff_own.targets[0..1] END) WHERE t IN (CASE WHEN eff_rival.operation = 'merge' THEN eff_rival.targets[1..] ELSE eff_rival.targets[0..1] END))
              OR ((CASE WHEN eff_rival.operation = 'merge' THEN eff_rival.targets[0] ELSE eff_rival.targets[1] END) IN (CASE WHEN eff_own.operation = 'merge' THEN eff_own.targets[1..] ELSE eff_own.targets[0..1] END) AND (CASE WHEN eff_own.operation = 'merge' THEN eff_own.targets[0] ELSE eff_own.targets[1] END) IN (CASE WHEN eff_rival.operation = 'merge' THEN eff_rival.targets[1..] ELSE eff_rival.targets[0..1] END))))
     OR ((eff_rival.operation = 'exclude_link' AND (eff_rival.link_kind IS NULL OR eff_rival.link_kind = 'merged_into')) AND (CASE WHEN eff_own.operation = 'merge' THEN eff_own.targets[0] ELSE eff_own.targets[1] END) IN eff_rival.targets
         AND any(t IN (CASE WHEN eff_own.operation = 'merge' THEN eff_own.targets[1..] ELSE eff_own.targets[0..1] END) WHERE t IN eff_rival.targets))))) OR (
     (eff_rival.operation = 'include_link' AND (eff_own.operation = 'exclude_link' AND (eff_own.link_kind IS NULL OR eff_own.link_kind = eff_rival.link_kind)) AND (eff_own.targets = eff_rival.targets OR eff_own.targets = reverse(eff_rival.targets)))
  OR ((eff_rival.operation = 'same_identity' OR (eff_rival.operation = 'include_link' AND eff_rival.link_kind = 'same_as')) AND (
        (eff_own.operation = 'different_identity' AND (eff_own.targets = eff_rival.targets OR eff_own.targets = reverse(eff_rival.targets)))
     OR ((eff_own.operation = 'exclude_link' AND (eff_own.link_kind IS NULL OR eff_own.link_kind = 'same_as')) AND (eff_own.targets = eff_rival.targets OR eff_own.targets = reverse(eff_rival.targets)))
     OR (eff_own.operation = 'split' AND (
           (eff_rival.targets[0] = eff_own.targets[0] AND eff_rival.targets[1] IN eff_own.targets[1..])
        OR (eff_rival.targets[1] = eff_own.targets[0] AND eff_rival.targets[0] IN eff_own.targets[1..])))))
  OR ((eff_rival.operation = 'resolve_mention' OR (eff_rival.operation = 'include_link' AND eff_rival.link_kind = 'resolves_to')) AND (
        ((eff_own.operation = 'resolve_mention' OR (eff_own.operation = 'include_link' AND eff_own.link_kind = 'resolves_to')) AND eff_own.targets[0] = eff_rival.targets[0] AND eff_own.targets[1] <> eff_rival.targets[1])
     OR (eff_own.operation = 'unresolve_mention' AND eff_own.targets[0] = eff_rival.targets[0])
     OR (eff_own.operation = 'different_identity' AND (eff_own.targets = eff_rival.targets OR eff_own.targets = reverse(eff_rival.targets)))
     OR ((eff_own.operation = 'exclude_link' AND (eff_own.link_kind IS NULL OR eff_own.link_kind = 'resolves_to')) AND (eff_own.targets = eff_rival.targets OR eff_own.targets = reverse(eff_rival.targets)))
     OR (eff_own.operation = 'split' AND eff_own.targets[0] = eff_rival.targets[1]
         AND eff_rival.targets[0] IN eff_own.targets[1..])))
  OR ((eff_rival.operation = 'merge' OR (eff_rival.operation = 'include_link' AND eff_rival.link_kind = 'merged_into')) AND (
        (eff_own.operation = 'split' AND eff_own.targets[0] IN eff_rival.targets
         AND any(part IN eff_own.targets[1..] WHERE part IN eff_rival.targets))
     OR (eff_own.operation = 'different_identity' AND all(t IN eff_own.targets WHERE t IN eff_rival.targets))
     OR ((eff_own.operation = 'merge' OR (eff_own.operation = 'include_link' AND eff_own.link_kind = 'merged_into')) AND (CASE WHEN eff_own.operation = 'merge' THEN eff_own.targets[0] ELSE eff_own.targets[1] END) <> (CASE WHEN eff_rival.operation = 'merge' THEN eff_rival.targets[0] ELSE eff_rival.targets[1] END)
         AND (any(t IN (CASE WHEN eff_rival.operation = 'merge' THEN eff_rival.targets[1..] ELSE eff_rival.targets[0..1] END) WHERE t IN (CASE WHEN eff_own.operation = 'merge' THEN eff_own.targets[1..] ELSE eff_own.targets[0..1] END))
              OR ((CASE WHEN eff_own.operation = 'merge' THEN eff_own.targets[0] ELSE eff_own.targets[1] END) IN (CASE WHEN eff_rival.operation = 'merge' THEN eff_rival.targets[1..] ELSE eff_rival.targets[0..1] END) AND (CASE WHEN eff_rival.operation = 'merge' THEN eff_rival.targets[0] ELSE eff_rival.targets[1] END) IN (CASE WHEN eff_own.operation = 'merge' THEN eff_own.targets[1..] ELSE eff_own.targets[0..1] END))))
     OR ((eff_own.operation = 'exclude_link' AND (eff_own.link_kind IS NULL OR eff_own.link_kind = 'merged_into')) AND (CASE WHEN eff_rival.operation = 'merge' THEN eff_rival.targets[0] ELSE eff_rival.targets[1] END) IN eff_own.targets
         AND any(t IN (CASE WHEN eff_rival.operation = 'merge' THEN eff_rival.targets[1..] ELSE eff_rival.targets[0..1] END) WHERE t IN eff_own.targets))))))
         | {key: eff_own.id, all: eff_rival.all, docs: eff_rival.docs}]) AS eff_rivals
  CALL (eff_hides) {
    UNWIND eff_hides AS eff_h
    WITH eff_h.key AS eff_k, collect({all: eff_h.all, docs: eff_h.docs}) AS eff_s
    RETURN apoc.map.fromPairs(collect([eff_k, eff_s])) AS eff_hidden
  }
  CALL (eff_rivals) {
    UNWIND eff_rivals AS eff_h
    WITH eff_h.key AS eff_k, collect({all: eff_h.all, docs: eff_h.docs}) AS eff_s
    RETURN apoc.map.fromPairs(collect([eff_k, eff_s])) AS eff_contested
  }
  RETURN eff_hidden, eff_contested,
         apoc.map.fromPairs([eff_h IN eff_hides | [split(eff_h.key, '|')[0], true]])
           AS eff_hiding,
         apoc.map.fromPairs([eff_s IN eff_corrections
                             | [eff_s.id, [{all: eff_s.all, docs: eff_s.docs}]]]) AS eff_scopes
}
WITH start, scope_ids, {hidden: eff_hidden, hiding: eff_hiding, scopes: eff_scopes,
   contested: eff_contested, apart_links: {}} AS eff_view
CALL (start, scope_ids, eff_view) {
  OPTIONAL MATCH (eff_apart:PDCorrection {status: 'active'})
  WHERE eff_apart.operation = 'different_identity'
  OPTIONAL MATCH (eff_x:PDGraphNode {id: eff_apart.targets[0]})
  OPTIONAL MATCH (eff_y:PDGraphNode {id: eff_apart.targets[1]})
  OPTIONAL MATCH eff_left = (eff_x)(()-[eff_l:PD_RELATION WHERE eff_l.kind = 'merged_into' AND (((coalesce(eff_l.origin, "") <> "automatic" OR eff_l.stage = "interpretation")
  AND coalesce(eff_l.current, true)) AND coalesce(startNode(eff_l).current, true) AND coalesce(endNode(eff_l).current, true)
  AND (eff_l.correction_id IS NOT NULL OR NOT ((eff_view.hiding[startNode(eff_l).id] IS NOT NULL
   OR eff_view.hidden['doc|' + coalesce(eff_l.document_id, '')] IS NOT NULL)
  AND any(eff_key IN [startNode(eff_l).id + '|' + endNode(eff_l).id + '|' + coalesce(eff_l.kind, ''), startNode(eff_l).id + '|' + endNode(eff_l).id + '|*', CASE WHEN eff_l.kind = 'resolves_to' AND coalesce(eff_l.origin, '') = 'automatic' THEN startNode(eff_l).id + '|*|resolves_to|A' ELSE '' END, CASE WHEN eff_l.kind = 'resolves_to' AND coalesce(eff_l.origin, '') = 'automatic' THEN startNode(eff_l).id + '|' + endNode(eff_l).id + '|resolves_to|A' ELSE '' END, CASE WHEN coalesce(eff_l.origin, '') = 'automatic' THEN 'doc|' + coalesce(eff_l.document_id, '') ELSE '' END] WHERE
      any(eff_hide IN coalesce(eff_view.hidden[eff_key], [])
          WHERE (eff_hide.all OR any(eff_doc IN eff_hide.docs WHERE eff_doc IN [eff_id IN [eff_l.document_id, startNode(eff_l).id, endNode(eff_l).id, startNode(eff_l).document_id, endNode(eff_l).document_id] WHERE eff_id IS NOT NULL]))))))
  AND (eff_l.correction_id IS NULL OR (eff_l.correction_id IS NOT NULL
  AND any(eff_source IN coalesce(eff_view.scopes[coalesce(eff_l.correction_id, '')], [])
          WHERE (eff_source.all OR any(eff_doc IN eff_source.docs WHERE eff_doc IN [eff_id IN [eff_l.document_id, startNode(eff_l).id, endNode(eff_l).id, startNode(eff_l).document_id, endNode(eff_l).document_id] WHERE eff_id IS NOT NULL]))))))]->())*(eff_join:PDGraphNode)
  OPTIONAL MATCH eff_right = (eff_y)(()-[eff_r:PD_RELATION WHERE eff_r.kind = 'merged_into' AND (((coalesce(eff_r.origin, "") <> "automatic" OR eff_r.stage = "interpretation")
  AND coalesce(eff_r.current, true)) AND coalesce(startNode(eff_r).current, true) AND coalesce(endNode(eff_r).current, true)
  AND (eff_r.correction_id IS NOT NULL OR NOT ((eff_view.hiding[startNode(eff_r).id] IS NOT NULL
   OR eff_view.hidden['doc|' + coalesce(eff_r.document_id, '')] IS NOT NULL)
  AND any(eff_key IN [startNode(eff_r).id + '|' + endNode(eff_r).id + '|' + coalesce(eff_r.kind, ''), startNode(eff_r).id + '|' + endNode(eff_r).id + '|*', CASE WHEN eff_r.kind = 'resolves_to' AND coalesce(eff_r.origin, '') = 'automatic' THEN startNode(eff_r).id + '|*|resolves_to|A' ELSE '' END, CASE WHEN eff_r.kind = 'resolves_to' AND coalesce(eff_r.origin, '') = 'automatic' THEN startNode(eff_r).id + '|' + endNode(eff_r).id + '|resolves_to|A' ELSE '' END, CASE WHEN coalesce(eff_r.origin, '') = 'automatic' THEN 'doc|' + coalesce(eff_r.document_id, '') ELSE '' END] WHERE
      any(eff_hide IN coalesce(eff_view.hidden[eff_key], [])
          WHERE (eff_hide.all OR any(eff_doc IN eff_hide.docs WHERE eff_doc IN [eff_id IN [eff_r.document_id, startNode(eff_r).id, endNode(eff_r).id, startNode(eff_r).document_id, endNode(eff_r).document_id] WHERE eff_id IS NOT NULL]))))))
  AND (eff_r.correction_id IS NULL OR (eff_r.correction_id IS NOT NULL
  AND any(eff_source IN coalesce(eff_view.scopes[coalesce(eff_r.correction_id, '')], [])
          WHERE (eff_source.all OR any(eff_doc IN eff_source.docs WHERE eff_doc IN [eff_id IN [eff_r.document_id, startNode(eff_r).id, endNode(eff_r).id, startNode(eff_r).document_id, endNode(eff_r).document_id] WHERE eff_id IS NOT NULL]))))))]->())*(eff_join)
  WITH start, scope_ids, eff_apart, eff_left, eff_right
  WHERE eff_right IS NOT NULL
  WITH start, scope_ids, eff_apart, eff_left, eff_right,
       nodes(eff_left) + nodes(eff_right) AS eff_nodes,
       relationships(eff_left) + relationships(eff_right) AS eff_links
  WHERE (eff_apart.scope = ['all'] OR EXISTS {
      MATCH (eff_document:PDDocument)
      WHERE eff_document.current_version_id IN eff_apart.scope
        AND eff_document.id IN [eff_n IN eff_nodes | eff_n.id] + [eff_n IN eff_nodes | eff_n.document_id] + [eff_m IN eff_links | eff_m.document_id] })
  UNWIND relationships(eff_left) + relationships(eff_right) AS eff_link
  WITH DISTINCT eff_apart.id AS eff_apart_id, eff_link.id AS eff_link_id,
       eff_link.correction_id AS eff_merge_id
  RETURN collect([eff_apart_id, eff_link_id, eff_merge_id]) AS eff_apart_pairs
}
WITH start, scope_ids, eff_apart_pairs,
     {hidden: eff_view.hidden, hiding: eff_view.hiding, scopes: eff_view.scopes,
       contested: eff_view.contested,
       apart_links: apoc.map.fromPairs([eff_p IN eff_apart_pairs | [eff_p[1], true]])}
       AS eff_view


MATCH p = SHORTEST 1 (start)(
()-[r:PD_RELATION|ABOUT|ATTACHMENT_OF WHERE
    (r.kind IS NULL OR size($kinds) = 0 OR r.kind IN $kinds)
    AND (r.kind IN $kinds
         OR NOT 'PDDefinition' IN labels(startNode(r)) + labels(endNode(r)))
    AND ((((coalesce(r.origin, "") <> "automatic" OR r.stage = "interpretation")
  AND coalesce(r.current, true)) AND coalesce(startNode(r).current, true) AND coalesce(endNode(r).current, true)
  AND (r.correction_id IS NOT NULL OR NOT ((eff_view.hiding[startNode(r).id] IS NOT NULL
   OR eff_view.hidden['doc|' + coalesce(r.document_id, '')] IS NOT NULL)
  AND any(eff_key IN [startNode(r).id + '|' + endNode(r).id + '|' + coalesce(r.kind, ''), startNode(r).id + '|' + endNode(r).id + '|*', CASE WHEN r.kind = 'resolves_to' AND coalesce(r.origin, '') = 'automatic' THEN startNode(r).id + '|*|resolves_to|A' ELSE '' END, CASE WHEN r.kind = 'resolves_to' AND coalesce(r.origin, '') = 'automatic' THEN startNode(r).id + '|' + endNode(r).id + '|resolves_to|A' ELSE '' END, CASE WHEN coalesce(r.origin, '') = 'automatic' THEN 'doc|' + coalesce(r.document_id, '') ELSE '' END] WHERE
      any(eff_hide IN coalesce(eff_view.hidden[eff_key], [])
          WHERE (eff_hide.all OR any(eff_doc IN eff_hide.docs WHERE eff_doc IN [eff_id IN [r.document_id, startNode(r).id, endNode(r).id, startNode(r).document_id, endNode(r).document_id] WHERE eff_id IS NOT NULL]))))))
  AND (r.correction_id IS NULL OR (r.correction_id IS NOT NULL
  AND any(eff_source IN coalesce(eff_view.scopes[coalesce(r.correction_id, '')], [])
          WHERE (eff_source.all OR any(eff_doc IN eff_source.docs WHERE eff_doc IN [eff_id IN [r.document_id, startNode(r).id, endNode(r).id, startNode(r).document_id, endNode(r).document_id] WHERE eff_id IS NOT NULL])))))) AND NOT (eff_view.apart_links[coalesce(r.id, '')] IS NOT NULL
      OR (r.correction_id IS NOT NULL
          AND any(eff_rival IN coalesce(eff_view.contested[coalesce(r.correction_id, '')], [])
                  WHERE (eff_rival.all OR any(eff_doc IN eff_rival.docs WHERE eff_doc IN [eff_id IN [r.document_id, startNode(r).id, endNode(r).id, startNode(r).document_id, endNode(r).document_id] WHERE eff_id IS NOT NULL]))))))
    AND ($at IS NULL OR ((r.valid_from IS NULL OR r.valid_from <= $at)
                         AND (r.valid_to IS NULL OR $at < r.valid_to)))
    AND ($collection_ids IS NULL
         OR ((r.document_id IS NULL OR r.document_id IN scope_ids)
             AND (r.collection_ids IS NULL
                  OR any(c IN r.collection_ids WHERE c IN $collection_ids))))
]-(x WHERE $collection_ids IS NULL OR x:PDIdentity OR x:PDDefinition
    OR x.id IN scope_ids OR x.document_id IN scope_ids
    OR any(c IN coalesce(x.collection_ids, []) WHERE c IN $collection_ids))
)+(target:PDGraphNode)
WHERE length(p) <= $depth AND target <> start
WITH start, head(collect(eff_view)) AS eff_view,
     collect({target: target, distance: length(p), links: relationships(p)}) AS walked
CALL (start, eff_view) {
  WITH start AS origin, eff_view
  OPTIONAL MATCH (held_alias:PDAlias {thing_id: origin.id})
OPTIONAL MATCH (held_survivor:PDGraphNode {id: held_alias.survivor_id})
WITH eff_view, coalesce(held_survivor, origin) AS origin
WITH eff_view,
       [{start_key: origin.id, start: origin, scope: null}] AS starts
  
CALL (starts, eff_view) {
  UNWIND starts AS each
  WITH each, each.start AS start, eff_view
  CALL (start) {
  WITH start WHERE start:PDDocument
  RETURN [start] AS seed_documents, null AS seed_held
  UNION ALL
  WITH start WHERE NOT start:PDDocument
  CALL (start) {
    CALL (start) {
  CALL (start) {
  MATCH (held_holder_record:PDHeld {thing_id: start.id})
  MATCH (holder:PDDocument)-[has:PD_HAS]->(held_holder_record)
  RETURN holder, {link: has.link, item: has.item, kind: has.kind, source_id: has.source_id, cite_start: has.cite_start, cite_end: has.cite_end} AS via
}
  WITH collect({holder: holder, via: via}) AS held, count(DISTINCT holder) AS having,
       apoc.map.fromPairs(collect([holder.id, true])) AS documents
  RETURN held, having, documents
}
    RETURN [each IN held | each.holder] AS seed_documents,
           {held: held, having: having, documents: documents} AS seed_held
  }
  RETURN seed_documents, seed_held
}
  RETURN collect({start_key: each.start_key, start: start, scope: each.scope,
                   seed_documents: seed_documents, seed_held: seed_held}) AS seeds
}
CALL (seeds) {
  UNWIND seeds AS seed
  UNWIND seed.seed_documents AS document
  WITH DISTINCT document
  WITH collect(document) AS documents
  CALL (documents) {
  UNWIND documents AS document
  MATCH (document)-[has:PD_HAS]->(held:PDHeld)
  MATCH (thing:PDGraphNode {id: held.thing_id})
  RETURN document, thing, {link: has.link, item: has.item, kind: has.kind, source_id: has.source_id, cite_start: has.cite_start, cite_end: has.cite_end} AS via, held.holders AS having
}
  WITH document.id AS document_id, collect(thing) AS things
  RETURN apoc.map.fromPairs(collect([document_id, things])) AS things_of
}
CALL (seeds, things_of) {
  UNWIND seeds AS seed
  CALL (seed, things_of) {
    CALL (seed, things_of) {
      UNWIND seed.seed_documents AS document
      UNWIND coalesce(things_of[document.id], []) AS thing
      RETURN thing
      UNION ALL
      WITH seed WHERE NOT 'PDDocument' IN labels(seed.start)
      RETURN seed.start AS thing
    }
    RETURN collect(DISTINCT thing) AS things
  }
  RETURN collect({start_key: seed.start_key, start: seed.start, scope: seed.scope,
                   seed_documents: seed.seed_documents, things: things}) AS seeded
}
CALL (seeds, seeded) {
  WITH seeded,
       apoc.map.fromPairs([seed IN seeds WHERE seed.seed_held IS NOT NULL
                           | [seed.start.id, seed.seed_held]]) AS known
  CALL (seeded, known) {
    UNWIND seeded AS seed
    UNWIND [thing IN seed.things WHERE known[thing.id] IS NULL] AS thing
    WITH DISTINCT thing
    CALL (thing) {
  CALL (thing) {
  MATCH (held_holder_record:PDHeld {thing_id: thing.id})
  MATCH (holder:PDDocument)-[has:PD_HAS]->(held_holder_record)
  RETURN holder, {link: has.link, item: has.item, kind: has.kind, source_id: has.source_id, cite_start: has.cite_start, cite_end: has.cite_end} AS via
}
  WITH collect({holder: holder, via: via}) AS held, count(DISTINCT holder) AS having,
       apoc.map.fromPairs(collect([holder.id, true])) AS documents
  RETURN held, having, documents
}
    RETURN collect([thing.id, {held: held, having: having, documents: documents}]) AS read
  }
  RETURN apoc.map.fromPairs(read + [id IN keys(known) | [id, known[id]]]) AS holdings_of
}

  RETURN seeded[0].things AS seed_things, holdings_of
}

CALL (walked) {
  UNWIND walked AS each
  WITH each.target AS target
  WITH target.id AS target_id, target
  OPTIONAL MATCH (held_alias:PDAlias {thing_id: target.id})
OPTIONAL MATCH (held_survivor:PDGraphNode {id: held_alias.survivor_id})
WITH target_id, coalesce(held_survivor, target) AS target
RETURN collect({target_id: target_id,
                                              survivor: target}) AS survivors
}
CALL (survivors, holdings_of) {
  UNWIND [each IN survivors WHERE NOT (NOT 'PDDocument' IN labels(each.survivor) AND holdings_of[each.survivor.id] IS NOT NULL) | each.survivor] AS seed
  WITH DISTINCT seed
  CALL (seed) {
  WITH seed WHERE seed:PDDocument
  RETURN [seed] AS seed_documents, null AS seed_held
  UNION ALL
  WITH seed WHERE NOT seed:PDDocument
  CALL (seed) {
    CALL (seed) {
  MATCH (held_holder_record:PDHeld {thing_id: seed.id})
  MATCH (holder:PDDocument)-[has:PD_HAS]->(held_holder_record)
  RETURN holder
}
    RETURN collect(DISTINCT holder) AS seed_documents, null AS seed_held
  }
  RETURN seed_documents, seed_held
}
  RETURN apoc.map.fromPairs(collect([seed.id, [document IN seed_documents | document.id]]))
         AS documents_of
}
CALL (seed_things, holdings_of) {
  UNWIND seed_things AS thing
  WITH thing, holdings_of[thing.id] AS holding
  UNWIND keys(holding.documents) AS document_id
  WITH document_id, collect({thing: thing, having: holding.having}) AS held
  RETURN apoc.map.fromPairs(collect([document_id, held])) AS things_of
}
CALL (survivors, holdings_of, documents_of, things_of) {
  UNWIND survivors AS each
  WITH each, things_of, holdings_of[each.survivor.id] AS own,
       CASE WHEN (NOT 'PDDocument' IN labels(each.survivor) AND holdings_of[each.survivor.id] IS NOT NULL) THEN keys(holdings_of[each.survivor.id].documents)
            ELSE documents_of[each.survivor.id] END AS target_documents
  UNWIND [null] + target_documents AS document_id
  UNWIND CASE WHEN document_id IS NULL
              THEN [held IN [own] WHERE held IS NOT NULL
                    | {thing: each.survivor, having: held.having}]
              ELSE coalesce(things_of[document_id], []) END AS held
  WITH each.target_id AS score_key, held
  
  WITH score_key AS score_key, held WHERE held.having > 0
  WITH DISTINCT score_key, held.thing AS thing, held.having AS having
  WITH score_key, thing, having ORDER BY having, thing.id
  WITH score_key, collect(1.0 / having) AS weights
  RETURN apoc.map.fromPairs(collect([score_key, reduce(total = 0.0, weight IN weights | total + weight)])) AS score_of

}

UNWIND walked AS each
WITH each.target AS target, each.distance AS distance, each.links AS links,
     coalesce(score_of[each.target.id], 0.0) AS relatedness
  ORDER BY relatedness DESC, distance, target.id
WITH collect({target: target, distance: distance, relatedness: relatedness,
              links: links}) AS found
CALL () {
  OPTIONAL MATCH (holdings_state:PDFreshness {id: 'holdings'})
  OPTIONAL MATCH (catch_up:PDFreshness {id: 'catch-up'})
  WITH coalesce(holdings_state.built, false) = true AS built,
       holdings_state.updating_since IS NOT NULL AS spread, catch_up.read_through AS read_through
  RETURN NOT built AS building, built AND spread AS updating,
         CASE WHEN built THEN read_through END AS as_of
}
RETURN building, updating, as_of, [f IN found[0..$max_nodes] |
        {target: f.target, distance: f.distance, relatedness: f.relatedness,
          path: [r IN f.links | {id: r.id, type: type(r), kind: r.kind, statement: r.statement, origin: r.origin,
       document_id: r.document_id, source_id: r.source_id,
       from: startNode(r).id, to: endNode(r).id}]}] AS nodes,
       size(found) > $max_nodes AS capped, size(found) AS reached

cases.name: walk_doc_d3
cases.statement:
OPTIONAL MATCH (node:PDGraphNode {id: $start_id})
OPTIONAL MATCH (hit:PDSearchSource {id: $start_id})
OPTIONAL MATCH (hit_document:PDDocument {id: hit.document_id})
WITH coalesce(node, hit_document) AS start
WHERE start IS NOT NULL

OPTIONAL MATCH (member:PDDocument)-[:MEMBER_OF]->(project:PDCollection)
WHERE $collection_ids IS NOT NULL AND project.id IN $collection_ids
WITH start, collect(DISTINCT member.id) AS scope_ids
CALL () {
  OPTIONAL MATCH (eff_c:PDCorrection {status: 'active'})
  OPTIONAL MATCH (eff_c)-[:CORRECTS]->(eff_t)
  WITH eff_c, collect(eff_t.id) AS eff_named
  OPTIONAL MATCH (eff_d:PDDocument) WHERE eff_d.current_version_id IN coalesce(eff_c.scope, [])
  WITH eff_c, eff_named, collect(eff_d.id) AS eff_docs
  WITH collect(CASE WHEN eff_c IS NULL THEN null
                    ELSE eff_c {.*, named: eff_named, docs: eff_docs,
                                all: eff_c.scope = ['all']} END) AS eff_corrections
  WITH eff_corrections,
       reduce(eff_all = [], eff_one IN eff_corrections | eff_all + (CASE
    WHEN eff_one.operation = 'exclude_link'
      THEN [eff_p IN [[eff_one.targets[0], eff_one.targets[1]],
                      [eff_one.targets[1], eff_one.targets[0]]] WHERE eff_p[0] IN eff_one.named
            | {key: eff_p[0] + '|' + eff_p[1] + '|' + coalesce(eff_one.link_kind, '*'),
               all: eff_one.all, docs: eff_one.docs}]
    WHEN eff_one.operation IN ['resolve_mention', 'unresolve_mention']
         OR (eff_one.operation = 'include_link' AND eff_one.link_kind = 'resolves_to')
      THEN [eff_m IN eff_one.targets[0..1] WHERE eff_m IN eff_one.named
            | {key: eff_m + '|*|resolves_to|A', all: eff_one.all, docs: eff_one.docs}]
    WHEN eff_one.operation = 'different_identity'
      THEN [eff_p IN [[eff_one.targets[0], eff_one.targets[1]],
                      [eff_one.targets[1], eff_one.targets[0]]] WHERE eff_p[0] IN eff_one.named
            | {key: eff_p[0] + '|' + eff_p[1] + '|resolves_to|A',
               all: eff_one.all, docs: eff_one.docs}]
    WHEN eff_one.operation = 'split'
      THEN [eff_m IN eff_one.targets[1..] WHERE eff_m IN eff_one.named
            | {key: eff_m + '|' + eff_one.targets[0] + '|resolves_to|A',
               all: eff_one.all, docs: eff_one.docs}]
    WHEN eff_one.operation = 'replace_interpretation' AND size(eff_one.targets) = 1
         AND eff_one.targets[0] IN eff_one.named
      THEN [{key: 'doc|' + eff_one.targets[0], all: eff_one.all, docs: eff_one.docs}]
    ELSE [] END)) AS eff_hides,
       reduce(eff_all = [], eff_own IN eff_corrections | eff_all + [eff_rival IN eff_corrections
         WHERE eff_rival.id <> eff_own.id
           AND any(eff_shared IN eff_rival.named WHERE eff_shared IN eff_own.targets)
           AND ((
     (eff_own.operation = 'include_link' AND (eff_rival.operation = 'exclude_link' AND (eff_rival.link_kind IS NULL OR eff_rival.link_kind = eff_own.link_kind)) AND (eff_rival.targets = eff_own.targets OR eff_rival.targets = reverse(eff_own.targets)))
  OR ((eff_own.operation = 'same_identity' OR (eff_own.operation = 'include_link' AND eff_own.link_kind = 'same_as')) AND (
        (eff_rival.operation = 'different_identity' AND (eff_rival.targets = eff_own.targets OR eff_rival.targets = reverse(eff_own.targets)))
     OR ((eff_rival.operation = 'exclude_link' AND (eff_rival.link_kind IS NULL OR eff_rival.link_kind = 'same_as')) AND (eff_rival.targets = eff_own.targets OR eff_rival.targets = reverse(eff_own.targets)))
     OR (eff_rival.operation = 'split' AND (
           (eff_own.targets[0] = eff_rival.targets[0] AND eff_own.targets[1] IN eff_rival.targets[1..])
        OR (eff_own.targets[1] = eff_rival.targets[0] AND eff_own.targets[0] IN eff_rival.targets[1..])))))
  OR ((eff_own.operation = 'resolve_mention' OR (eff_own.operation = 'include_link' AND eff_own.link_kind = 'resolves_to')) AND (
        ((eff_rival.operation = 'resolve_mention' OR (eff_rival.operation = 'include_link' AND eff_rival.link_kind = 'resolves_to')) AND eff_rival.targets[0] = eff_own.targets[0] AND eff_rival.targets[1] <> eff_own.targets[1])
     OR (eff_rival.operation = 'unresolve_mention' AND eff_rival.targets[0] = eff_own.targets[0])
     OR (eff_rival.operation = 'different_identity' AND (eff_rival.targets = eff_own.targets OR eff_rival.targets = reverse(eff_own.targets)))
     OR ((eff_rival.operation = 'exclude_link' AND (eff_rival.link_kind IS NULL OR eff_rival.link_kind = 'resolves_to')) AND (eff_rival.targets = eff_own.targets OR eff_rival.targets = reverse(eff_own.targets)))
     OR (eff_rival.operation = 'split' AND eff_rival.targets[0] = eff_own.targets[1]
         AND eff_own.targets[0] IN eff_rival.targets[1..])))
  OR ((eff_own.operation = 'merge' OR (eff_own.operation = 'include_link' AND eff_own.link_kind = 'merged_into')) AND (
        (eff_rival.operation = 'split' AND eff_rival.targets[0] IN eff_own.targets
         AND any(part IN eff_rival.targets[1..] WHERE part IN eff_own.targets))
     OR (eff_rival.operation = 'different_identity' AND all(t IN eff_rival.targets WHERE t IN eff_own.targets))
